text:
alex: Quick design sync — I'm putting together the console flow for fallback choreography. Want to land on a small checklist before I mock screens. Key questions: what degrade-modes do we show, who can edit triggers, and what audit info do we surface? @miguel @sara

miguel: Love it. Minimal set I'd expect: model-variant swap, cached-response, degraded-sample-rate, and fast-404 for extreme failures. Also need a 'silent' mode (no customer-facing error) vs 'noisy' mode (logs + alert).

sara: Agree. Also we should show estimated cost delta for each mode. Degrading to a smaller model has cost + latency tradeoffs, cached responses might save tokens but risk staleness.

alex: UX question — do we expose trigger types in the same panel (latency, error-rate, cost-per-token, quota-breach) or separate? I'm leaning unified rules with typed triggers.

jordan: Unified is ok but allow an 'advanced' view with boolean AND/OR combos. For most customers simple triggers suffice: error-rate > X or 95th-latency > Y.

miguel: For audit, we must capture: who created rule, exact trigger snapshot (metrics & window), rollout fraction, and timestamped activations/deactivations. Also a button to 'replay' the trigger with logs.

alex: Draft API shape (for console + infra) — thoughts?
```json
{"fallback_policy": {"modes": ["model_swap"], "triggers": [{"type":"error_rate","threshold":0.1,"window_s":120}], "rollout_fraction":0.5}}
```

sara: API looks fine. Add an optional field `expected_quality_impact` (string enum low/medium/high) so we can show a quality warning in UI.

jordan: Also include `telemetry_tags` so telemetry can attribute events to this policy id. Otherwise auditor can't tie outcome to policy.

miguel: Ops edge-case — if a policy toggles frequently we should enforce a cooldown (e.g. 10m). Add that to API and default to 5m.

alex: Good call. UX wise we'll show the cooldown next to active indicators and in timeline. For audit log we can surface a compact timeline entry: activated by X at T, routed to model Y, fallback duration, reason.

ops-bot: deploy-bot changed status: canary rollout of fallback-engine v2 started by @alex

sara: One more ask — allow 'preview' to simulate fallback on a sample request set without affecting live traffic.

miguel: Agree, preview should run in read-only mode and emit a diff of outputs + cost estimates.

alex: Nice. I'll update mockups and API PR with `expected_quality_impact`, `telemetry_tags`, and `cooldown_s`. Will post sketches by EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
